Curious? Let's Clear Things Up.

Everything you need to know about Innhance's WhatsApp booking engine.

Innhance responds to guests instantly, usually within seconds. This ensures that no inquiry goes unanswered and helps improve booking conversion rates.
Yes! Innhance integrates seamlessly with most major PMS and booking engines, allowing real-time availability sync and instant booking confirmation.
Absolutely. Innhance supports over 20 languages, including Hindi, English, Spanish, Arabic etc. ensuring you can serve guests from anywhere in their preferred language.
We provide secure UPI and Card payment links directly within the WhatsApp chat. Guests can pay quickly and safely, and the payment is routed directly to your hotel's account.
If Innhance encounters a complex query it cannot handle, it seamlessly transfers the conversation to a human staff member, notifying them so they can take over without the guest noticing.
